//: Docs-only tsconfig for the TypeDoc analysis pass. It inherits the SDK's compiler settings verbatim and roots the program at the public entry point only: TypeScript pulls in whatever that entry point transitively imports, but a glob like `../src/**/*.ts` would also root unreachable internal modules (e.g. the `cli/` bin, which needs the optional `esbuild` peer dependency) that the docs toolchain has no reason to install.
